}

export function updateName(args: UpdateNameArgs): ExecQuery {

        kind: "exec",
        sql: updateNameQuery,
        params: [args["name"], args["id"]]
    };
}

export interface GetUserRow {
    "id": number;
    "nickname": string | null;
}

function parseGetUserRow(row: Record<string, unknown>): GetUserRow {
    return {
        "id": row["id"] as number,

    };
}

export function getUser(): OneQuery<GetUserRow> {
    return {
        kind: "one",
        sql: getUserQuery,
        params: [],

    };
}

const createUserQuery = "INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES (?) RETURNING id;";

export interface CreateUserArgs {
    "name": string;
}

export interface CreateUserRow {
    "id": number;
}

function parseCreateUserRow(row: Record<string, unknown>): CreateUserRow {
    return {
        "id": row["id"] as number
    };
}

export function createUser(args: CreateUserArgs): OneInsertQuery<CreateUserRow> {
    return {
        kind: "one-insert",
        sql: createUserQuery,
        params: [args["name"]],
        parse: parseCreateUserRow
    };
}
